resources.string: Keep in mind
Face Unlock works with most glasses. If you only wear glasses some of the time, set up your face while wearing them.

Looking at your phone can unlock it even when you don\u2019t intend to. Your phone can also be unlocked by someone who looks a lot like you, such as an identical sibling, or if someone holds it up to your face.
To make Face Unlock harder to use without you, turn on Require eyes to be open so your phone unlocks only when your eyes are open.
Using your face to unlock your phone may be less secure than a strong pattern, PIN, or password.
How it works
Face Unlock uses the front camera to build a model of your face. The model is kept on your phone. It is not shared with apps and is not sent off the device.
You\u2019re in control
You can turn off Face Unlock or delete your face model at any time in Settings. While it is on, the model is used only to confirm that it\u2019s you.
Hold your phone about an arm\u2019s length away and look at the screen. Move your head slowly in a circle so that the outline fills in completely.
Hold your phone about an arm\u2019s length away and look at the screen. You can finish setup without moving your head, though it may take longer.
Use your face to unlock your phone or to verify it\u2019s you in apps
Require eyes to be open
Your eyes must be open for your face to unlock your phone.
Face Unlock works with most glasses. If your child only wears glasses some of the time, set up their face while they are wearing them.

Looking at the phone can unlock it even when your child doesn\u2019t intend to. The phone can also be unlocked by someone who looks a lot like them, such as an identical sibling, or if someone holds it up to their face.
To make Face Unlock harder to use without your child, turn on Require eyes to be open so the phone unlocks only when their eyes are open.
Using a face to unlock the phone may be less secure than a strong pattern, PIN, or password.
Face Unlock uses the front camera to build a model of your child\u2019s face. The model is kept on the phone. It is not shared with apps and is not sent off the device.
You\u2019re in control
You can turn off Face Unlock or delete your child\u2019s face model at any time in Settings. While it is on, the model is used only to confirm that it\u2019s them.
